name: DeroPay Documentation
description: Read-only agent surface for DeroPay and DeroAuth — DERO-native payment processing, wallet authentication, on-chain escrow, and HTTP 402 (x402) payment-required guards. Covers Next.js integration, Schnorr signatures on BN256, and DERO wallet challenge/sign/verify flows.

skills.name: Integrate DERO-native payments
skills.description: Add DERO payment processing to a web application — invoice generation, payment monitoring, settlement, and reconciliation against on-chain state.
examples: Add DeroPay to a Next.js checkout flow.
How does DeroPay detect a paid invoice?
What is the settlement model for DeroPay?

skills.name: Implement DeroAuth wallet login
skills.description: Wire challenge/sign/verify wallet authentication using the `dero-auth` package. Covers Schnorr signatures on BN256, custom generator point, Keccak-256 hashing, and Bech32 address encoding.
examples: Implement Sign In with DERO on my web app.
How does DeroAuth verify a wallet signature server-side?

skills.name: Gate routes with HTTP 402 (x402)
skills.description: Use DeroPay's x402 guard to charge per-request access to API routes and resources, denominated in DERO and settled on-chain.
examples: Add an x402 guard to a Next.js API route.
How does x402 settle payment on-chain?
What headers does the x402 challenge response include?

skills.name: Search and navigate DeroPay documentation
skills.description: Full-text search across the DeroPay docs corpus — payments, auth, escrow, x402. Every page has a `.md` mirror for direct agent ingestion.
examples: Find docs on the DeroPay escrow contract.
How do I test DeroPay against a local simulator?

none.description: Public read-only documentation; site content requires no authentication. Daemon RPC, wallet RPC, and hosted MCP HTTP transport apply their own authentication where configured.

privacy_posture.rationale: DERO is a privacy-first chain; its docs surface honors the same posture.
